run: 2026-11-11 recheck of AgentOps 3.12.0 after the catalog audit (bead age-n3cv.13)

runner.effort: medium requested by environment variable; not recorded in traces

judge.method: grade.py judge call, one per response, blind to arm and version; mapping opened after grading
judge.calibration: 34 of 34 hand-written wave-3 answers graded as expected

rules.score: share of judge criteria met, pooled over a case's runs in one arm
rules.headroom: without-skill score of the case is 0.70 or below (wave 3's registered informative bar)
rules.suspect_score: a case with headroom whose 3.12 with-skill score (forced, or natural) is below the stored 3.11 Opus-graded score of the same arm and request by more than 0.15, or any case with headroom on a reshaped skill where a forced run misses a criterion in at least 2 of 3 runs
rules.suspect_loading: a skill whose loads (routing plus natural behavior runs) are at least 2 fewer than the stored 3.11 count on the same requests
rules.confirm_score: same-judge: Fable 5.2 regrades the stored 3.11 transcripts of the same request and arm with the current criteria, blind and mixed with the 3.12 responses; where the request or criteria changed since 3.11, or no stored transcript exists, the 3.11 text runs as a same-day third arm. Confirmed when same-judge 3.11 minus 3.12 exceeds 0.15 on a case with headroom.
rules.confirm_loading: same-day 3.11-text arm against 3.12 on the same requests, 6 runs per request; confirmed when the 3.12 rate is lower by 0.33 or more
rules.repair_bar: re-run of the repaired skill's cases meets or exceeds the same-judge 3.11 score (and loading rate where loading regressed)
rules.no_fix: no fix for a skill whose only finding is no headroom; no description-line change without a same-day measured trial

suspect: forced misses c3 in 2+ of 3 runs
forced misses c2,c3 in 2+ of 3 runs
forced misses c2 in 2+ of 3 runs
forced misses c4 in 2+ of 3 runs
forced misses c4 in 2+ of 3 runs
